correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed product c_n=3^n/n! product_{h=0}^{n-1}(3h+1) and the 2-adic carry count from the -2/3 binary expansion 0101... . For n<4^L no carry survives past the 2L input bits; direct four-choice two-bit transition counting gives exact 2x2 matrix, including L=0. Its trace 2+z+2z^2 and determinant 4z^2 give the rational generating function. Differentiating the recurrence gives the exact stated mean and variance; the dominant analytic eigenvalue at z=1 is 4, with derivatives 4 and 16/3, the other eigenvalue 1, so quasi-power characteristic functions give the CLT. Independently enumerated valuations via the coefficient ratio for all 21845 samples in blocks L=0..7 and matched complete histogram and rational moments to the transfer, using /mnt/data/independent_math_checks_scope05.py. This finite sample is not the CLT proof.
